title: Tensor normalization of the ordinary etale ordered affine-space counit
statement:
Let $N\geq1$, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$, and let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning one with a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme], on which $N$ is invertible. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with exact inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact] and derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. For $d\geq0$ let $p_d:X_d=\mathbf A^d_S\to S$ [def-sbc-affine-space], put $W_d=A_{X_d}(d)[2d]$ with the ordinary Tate lines and canonical pullback/tensor comparisons [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], and write $G_dK=p_d^*K\otimes_A^LW_d$.
Use exactly the ordered affine-line composite adjunction of [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace]: on each line compose open extension with the normalized projective-line adjunction of [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-adjunction], and use the identity adjunction at $d=0$. Identify its left functor with $Rp_{d!}$ by the proper/open-normalized compact-support compositor [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons], and its right functor with $G_d$ by the canonical ordered Tate/shift reassociation. Denote its counit by $\varepsilon^{(d)}_K:Rp_{d!}G_dK\to K$, and its trace at the coefficient unit by $t_d=\varepsilon^{(d)}_{A_S}:Rp_{d!}W_d\to A_S$.
For every $K\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ the actual counit satisfies
$$\varepsilon^{(d)}_K=\rho_K\circ(1_K\otimes t_d)\circ P_{p_d;K,W_d}^{-1}.$$
Here $\rho_K:K\otimes_A^LA_S\to K$ is the canonical right unitor, and $P_{p_d;K,W_d}:K\otimes_A^LRp_{d!}W_d\to Rp_{d!}(p_d^*K\otimes_A^LW_d)$ is the canonical coefficient-first compact-support projection: the proper projection of [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection] followed by the open tensor comparison of [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor] on a compactification [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. No boundedness, constructibility, or finite Tor-amplitude condition on $K$ is assumed. The formula includes $d=0$, the zero ring, and the empty scheme.

proof.text: The proper finite-coefficient projection is invertible. Both signed symmetries, the exact/left-derived inverse-image comparison, and the open tensor comparison are invertible; therefore their specified compactification composite is invertible on the arbitrary unbounded inputs in the statement. Use asIso of that very map, fixing its hom without a choice.

proof.text: Cancel the forward compact-support projection. The structural projection/reassociation theorem identifies its composite with the inverse right reassociation and inverse ordered left comparison. This structural comparison contains no adjunction counit or projective-line data.

proof.text: Use naturality of the actual ordered composite counit with respect to the right unitor on K. The ordered coefficient counit square, obtained by pasting the normalized proper counit square and open counit square and induction over coordinates, then moves the coefficient K outside the composite counit. This square applies to all unbounded K and to the constant single unit as its second input.

proof.text: Functoriality combines the mapped inverse Tate comparison, inverse left comparison, and the tower counit. By the unchanged definition of trace their composite is the given trace. The remaining arrow is precisely the specified right unitor. This proves the formula, including dimension zero, the empty base and the zero ring.
